commands.commandLine: powershell.exe -Command "Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue sample.csv,table.csv,freq.csv,ref.bin,py.bin,ref.err,py.err,ref.out; if(Test-Path __pycache__){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force __pycache__}; python -m py_compile .\\xsv_port.py; cmd /c .\\executable.cmd --version; '' | cmd /c .\\executable.cmd count --no-headers; git status --short"
